title: IngestionConfig
description: Stream ingestion scheduler configuration schema enforcing pacing, backpressure, and backoff commandments (Commandments 1, 5, 8)

max_concurrent_streams.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active RTSP decoders allowed in memory (Commandment 8)

inference_fps.description: Paced inference sampling rate per stream in frames per second (Commandment 8: 1-2 FPS sub-sampling)

batch_size.description: Number of camera streams grouped into each active round-robin processing batch

batch_rotation_interval_seconds.description: Duration in seconds before round-robin rotation switches to the next batch of camera streams

frame_queue_max_size.description: Bounded frame queue capacity between decoder workers and inference workers

backpressure_strategy.description: Queue policy applied when frame queue reaches frame_queue_max_size

gpu_memory_threshold_mb.description: GPU VRAM ceiling in megabytes triggering automatic dynamic throttling or down-scaling

reconnect_initial_delay_ms.description: Initial backoff delay in milliseconds before first reconnect attempt on stream drop (Commandment 5: 2s)

reconnect_max_delay_ms.description: Maximum exponential backoff delay ceiling in milliseconds (Commandment 5: 30s max)

reconnect_backoff_multiplier.description: Exponential multiplier applied to delay after each subsequent reconnect failure
